name: hedwig-film
description: 60-second launch film for Hedwig, built in Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render HedwigDemo out/hedwig-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --crf=14 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hedwig-demo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 26 -tune grain -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy out/tmp.mp4 && mv out/tmp.mp4 out/hedwig-demo.mp4
